name: 50ml Neutral Grease Leather Dublin , Protects, Nourishes & Softens Your Leather Products
description:
Softens, protects and nourishes oily leather items and dark-colored nappa, preventing them from ageing.

Application:
1) Clean the surface which you want to protect.
2)Apply the grease with the cloth, in small quantities, rubbing on the garment in a circular way until it penetrates the pores and thus obtains a perfect finish.
3)Allow to dry for a day until it penetrates very well into the article.

name: Minimalist Leather Backpack Personalized Front Engraving
description:
This customisable backpack is the epitome of minimalist elegance. Crafted from high-quality leather, it exudes sophistication and refinement. The backpack features a sleek design that's perfect for those who prefer a more understated look.


🔷The main compartment is spacious enough to fit a laptop of up to 15 inches.
🔷In addition to the laptop compartment, the backpack features a front pocket that's perfect for storing smaller items like your phone, keys, or wallet.

The backpack also comes with a strap that can be attached to your suitcase for easy transport during air travel. This strap allows you to securely attach the backpack to your rolling suitcase, making it a great choice for frequent travelers.

Overall, this customisable leather backpack is the perfect combination of style and function. It's a versatile and practical option for anyone looking for a minimalist yet elegant way to carry their laptop and other essentials.
